concept.title: Glossary and index
concept.shortdesc: Publications that use DITA glossary entries, index markup, or a bookmap's booklists get generated glossary, index, figure-list and table-list pages, linked from every page's footer as GOV.UK support links.

conbody.p: glossaryindexBoth pages are built from your source with no configuration:

section.title: Glossary
section.p: Every glossentry topic referenced from the map — including resource-only key definitions — appears on the glossary page, sorted A to Z with letter navigation, showing its term, acronym, and definition, linked to the full entry. In running text, a reference like expands on first use and shows the acronym thereafter (), while a term reference such as transtype links to its definition with a tooltip.

section.title: Index
section.p: indexentries and sub-entriesAdd indexterm markup anywhere in your topics and the index page collects every term with links to the pages where it appears. Nested terms become indented sub-entries, and index-see cross-references render as see lines. This manual indexes its own pages — follow the Index link in the footer to see the result.

section.title: Figure and table lists
section.p: A bookmap can ask for a list of figures or tables through its front-matter booklists:

Each requested list becomes its own page, numbering every titled figure or table in reading order and linking to it — to the figure or table itself where it has an @id, otherwise to its topic. The Figures and Tables links then join the footer's support links. This manual requests both; follow those links to see the result.
